result.summary: This PR changes TestBlockValidity to reuse the chainstate's CoinsViewOverlay (the same parallel-prevout-fetching mechanism added in #35295) instead of creating a fresh CCoinsViewCache, so parallel input fetching now speeds up block-template validation, not just chain-tip connection. It also reworks the AssembleBlock benchmark to actually fill blocks to max weight so the resulting speedup is visible and measurable, showing roughly a 10% improvement locally. A small validation.h accessor (ConnectBlockView()) is added to expose the shared overlay.
result.problem: TestBlockValidity (used when validating externally-proposed block templates, e.g. via getblocktemplate or the Stratum v2 Job Declarator Server) previously built input prevouts serially through a fresh cache, missing the parallel-fetch speedup already applied to normal block connection. Miners and template-validating tools that call this path repeatedly pay an avoidable performance cost.

open_concerns: l0rinc: reusing the shared ConnectBlockView() in TestBlockValidity creates a theoretical reentrancy hazard if a future synchronous BlockChecked callback calls TestBlockValidity while ConnectTip's fetch is still active; requested a regression test or safeguard before merge.
Benchmark nits from l0rinc (move semantics, loop style, brace style) not yet addressed since they were secondary to the reentrancy point.
resolved_concerns: optout21's naming confusion (view_dummy vs view_shared) resolved by renaming to overlay_view.
optout21's question about the other m_connect_block_view usage in ConnectTip resolved by switching it to also use ConnectBlockView().

Initial disagreement over whether the performance claim was real was resolved once sedited and l0rinc reproduced the regression and the author fixed the benchmark to fill blocks to max weight, showing a real ~10% speedup.

Whether the project intends TestBlockValidity's speedup to matter much given Sjors notes #35671's TxCollection may supersede this path for mining use cases.
result.card: This PR makes TestBlockValidity reuse the chainstate's parallel-prevout-fetching CoinsViewOverlay instead of a fresh per-call cache, extending the ConnectBlock speedup from #35295 to block-template validation, and reworks the AssembleBlock benchmark to fill blocks to max weight so the ~10% speedup is actually visible. Sjors gave concept ACK, noting this indirectly speeds up the checkBlock() IPC call used by the Stratum v2 Job Declarator Server. l0rinc requested changes over a theoretical reentrancy hazard from reusing the shared overlay across TestBlockValidity and ConnectTip; the author agreed to add a defensive assert but has not pushed it since 2026-08-23, leaving the PR Paused waiting on that fix. No merge dependency, but the design may interact with the in-progress #35671 TxCollection mining work. Priority is moderate: a real but narrow performance win for a specific mining-adjacent consumer, not a correctness fix.
